title: Cubic Curves in F_p^2
exact_target: Does every planar set over a large prime field with no three points on a line lie almost entirely on a curve of degree at most three?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 129 (GREEN-041). CC BY 4.0.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, maintained author collection, Problem 68 and its comments, accessed 7 October 2026.
